test_title: PYST 8: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct Active Voice form of the given sentence:

The call was being made by Shyam.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Active voice describes a sentence where the subject performs the action expressed by the verb.
 
• The given sentence is in passive voice: "The call was being made by Shyam."
 
• To convert this sentence into active voice, place the subject ("Shyam") at the beginning of the sentence.
 
• Convert the verb form from passive ("was being made") to active ("was making").
 
• The resulting sentence is: "Shyam was making the call."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"Shyam was making the call."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Shyam makes the call." – Incorrect tense (present simple instead of past continuous).
 
• **Option 3:** "Shyam made the call." – Incorrect tense (past simple instead of past continuous).
 
• **Option 4:** "The call made Shyam." – Incorrect meaning and grammatical structure.

5d:T
